opportunities.title: William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants apply for church conservation projects via the 'William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants' application form on the Society's Grants Application Portal. No references are required.
opportunities.summary: Church conservation grants supporting the conservation of church buildings and monuments. Two application rounds each year (31 March and 31 August). No references are required for applications.

opportunities.title: Linda Parry Textile Conservation and Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants apply via the 'William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants' form on the Grants Application Portal. No references are required.
opportunities.summary: Grants for textile conservation and research. Applications are made using the 'William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants' form on the Society's Grants Application Portal, and no references are required.
